name: cerberus-poker
description: Solana SDK for multiplayer card games with complete information privacy via Arcium MPC and Confidential SPL tokens

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names "VALIDATOR,PROGRAMS,UI" -c "bgBlue.bold,bgMagenta.bold,bgGreen.bold" "npm run dev:validator" "npm run dev:programs" "npm run dev:ui"
scripts.dev:programs: wait-on tcp:8899 && cd packages/programs && anchor build && anchor deploy && echo '✅ Programs deployed! Update program IDs in Anchor.toml and examples/poker-ui/src/lib/anchor.ts'
scripts.dev:ui: wait-on tcp:8899 && cd examples/poker-ui && npm run dev
scripts.deploy:local: cd packages/programs && anchor build && anchor deploy
